name: XLA_MPA_JLT_AC_ASSGNS
description: This table contains the analytical criteria assigned to multiperiod journal lines for accrual journal line types of a journal lines definition.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Internal context code that is associated to accounting method builder.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: LINE_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a journal line definition.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal line rule is predefined by subledger application.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Short name associated with the rule to convert transactional data into a journal entry line.

columns.name: MPA_ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of multiperiod journal line.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Multiperiod journal line analytical criterion owner code.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_CODE
columns.description: Multiperiod journal line analytical criterion code.

columns.name: MPA_INHERIT_AC_FLAG
columns.description: Decides whether the analytical criteria for the multiperiod accrual journal line is inherited from its parent journal line.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
